mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, and selegiline at higher doses (>10mg/day) may increase risk of hematologic complications; additionally, selegiline's MAOI properties at higher doses could theoretically potentiate sympathomimetic effects in hyperthyroid patients.
action: Monitor blood counts regularly during concurrent use; maintain selegiline at lower doses (≤10mg/day); counsel patient on signs of infection or unusual bleeding.
